title: V3 classic heading widget — flat scalar settings (header_size, align, title_color), no typed envelopes
_comment: WP-Q01 V3 VALID fixture (Detailed-Req #5; 11-authoring-contract.md §2.3 classic node). The classic heading uses a FLAT assoc settings map of scalar control values (title, header_size, align, title_color) — NO typed envelopes, NO styles map; CSS is control-selector driven. requires.experiments is EMPTY (classic V3 needs no atomic experiment) so this runs on a free-only / atomic-off install. VERIFIED valid:true via Validator::dry_run on Elementor 4.1.1. prefilter.verdict:defer — the pre-filter cannot prove a flat classic settings map and defers to PHP (§4).
